import * as SelectPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-select"
import { Check, ChevronDown } from "lucide-react"
import type { ComponentProps } from "react"

export const Select = SelectPrimitive.Root
export function SelectTrigger({ children, className = "", ...props }: ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return <SelectPrimitive.Trigger className={`select-trigger ${className}`} {...props}>
    {children}<SelectPrimitive.Icon><ChevronDown size={14} /></SelectPrimitive.Icon>
  </SelectPrimitive.Trigger>
}
export const SelectValue = SelectPrimitive.Value
export function SelectContent(props: ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Content>) {
  return <SelectPrimitive.Portal><SelectPrimitive.Content className="select-content" position="popper" {...props}>
    <SelectPrimitive.Viewport>{props.children}</SelectPrimitive.Viewport>
  </SelectPrimitive.Content></SelectPrimitive.Portal>
}
export function SelectItem({ children, ...props }: ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Item>) {
  return <SelectPrimitive.Item className="select-item" {...props}>
    <SelectPrimitive.ItemText>{children}</SelectPrimitive.ItemText>
    <SelectPrimitive.ItemIndicator><Check size={13} /></SelectPrimitive.ItemIndicator>
  </SelectPrimitive.Item>
}
